description: This file defines the class One2MBeanRelationship, which manages a one-to-many, table-based relationship in a CRM system, including methods for adding, removing, loading, and querying relationships between entities.

classes.name: One2MBeanRelationship
classes.description: Represents a one-to-many relationship that is table based, with methods to manage relationships between two beans.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a relationship between two beans, handling relationship existence checks, link updates, and optional related bean saving.

methods.name: updateLinks
methods.description: Updates the relationship links between the left-hand side (LHS) and right-hand side (RHS) beans.

methods.name: updateFields
methods.description: Sets the RHS bean's key and additional fields, including relationship role fields.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the relationship between two beans, optionally saving the RHS bean afterward.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads related beans based on the link side and query parameters.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Builds an SQL query or query array to retrieve related bean IDs based on relationship definitions and parameters.

methods.name: getJoin
methods.description: Generates SQL JOIN statements to incorporate the relationship into larger queries, with support for aliases and filtering.

methods.name: getSubpanelQuery
methods.description: Creates SQL JOINs for subpanel display, considering activity filters and aliases.

methods.name: relationship_exists
methods.description: Checks if a relationship already exists between two beans based on fetched data and IDs.

methods.name: getRelationshipTable
methods.description: Returns the name of the relationship table or the RHS table name if unspecified.
